text.en: Pet owners in Deer Valley consistently praise Dr. Reynolds and the front desk team on West Greenway Road for their warmth, honesty, and thorough approach. Both new visitors and long-standing clients who have attended since the 1990s express high trust in the staff.

title.en: Patient care for cats and dogs

text.en: Reviewers highlight how gently the veterinary team handles senior cats, multiple-dog households, and giant breeds such as Great Danes and Saint Bernards. Owners note that their pets stay relaxed and comfortable throughout routine check-ups and dental procedures.

title.en: Fair fees without pressure or upselling

text.en: Clients frequently describe the clinic's pricing for wellness exams, vaccinations, X-rays, and neutering as fair and noticeably more affordable than corporate veterinary chains. Reviewers also appreciate that Dr. Reynolds offers clear options without overselling.

q.en: Can Amherst Plaza Animal Clinic accommodate urgent Saturday visits?

a.en: Yes, the clinic is open on Saturday mornings until 14:00, and reviewers mention securing last-minute Saturday appointments for X-rays and senior cat emergencies.

q.en: What payment options does Amherst Plaza Animal Clinic accept?

a.en: According to client feedback, the clinic accepts debit and credit cards but does not take CareCredit.

q.en: Does the clinic perform feline dental surgery?

a.en: Yes, the clinic provides veterinary dentistry and oral surgery, with reviewers praising the care given to cats during dental procedures.
